rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name + old ZIP and only then accessed account details. It did not perform any write without explicit confirmation and correctly stated it would confirm before updating the address. The user declined to provide a new address, so no update could be completed; the agent appropriately explained the need for address details and offered alternatives. For the product query, the agent used tools to find the cheapest available T-shirt and reported accurate details ($46.66, red, L, cotton v‑neck). When asked to place a new order, the agent correctly declined given tool limitations. One minor inconsistency was suggesting the user could provide just city/state/ZIP, which may not suffice for a full address update, but no incorrect action was taken and later the agent reiterated the need for full address details. Overall, the interaction adhered to policy and provided correct information, though the core update was not completed due to missing user input.
